title: Fat Transfer Malaysia | Natural Volume Restoration – Dr. Soma
description: Fat transfer surgery in Malaysia by Dr. Soma. Natural volume restoration using your own body fat for face, breast, buttocks and body contouring. Certified plastic surgeon with hospital-grade safety. Book consultation today.

acceptedAnswer.text: Fat transfer is a surgical procedure that removes fat from one area of the body and injects it into another area to restore volume and improve contour.
The fat that survives after the first few months is generally permanent, as long as body weight remains stable.
When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a licensed medical facility, fat transfer is considered a safe and established procedure.
Most patients return to normal daily activities within 1–2 weeks, with final results visible after several months.

mainEntity.name: Will the transferred fat feel natural?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because it is your own tissue, transferred fat feels soft and natural once healed.

mainEntity.name: Can fat transfer be combined with other procedures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is commonly combined with liposuction, body contouring, or facial rejuvenation procedures.

mainEntity.name: How much fat survives after transfer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, 60–80% of transferred fat survives long term, depending on technique and individual healing.

mainEntity.name: Who should not undergo fat transfer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patients with very low body fat, unstable weight, or uncontrolled medical conditions may not be suitable candidates.
